end.parentNote: Asha practised naming halves, thirds and quarters using equal sharing, grouped pencils, watermelon, chocolate, and cricket runs. Nisha explained that equal groups help show the bottom number and identified 5 pencils in each of 3 groups. They continued to mix up whether the top number refers to parts taken or parts left; this was not corrected by the end, and the teach-back was not passed. At home, use one roti or fruit divided into equal parts and repeatedly ask, “How many equal parts altogether?” and “How many are we talking about?”
